properties.name: kansas
properties.note: Where the self-hosted Valhalla (Geofabrik Kansas extract) routes. Hand-drawn from the state's straight borders; the north-east corner is cut along a line inside the Missouri River so towns across the river (St. Joseph, Kansas City MO) go to the fallback provider. The extract carries a buffer beyond the border, so routes near the edges still have their roads. docs/design/routing.md §13.5.
